title: MarkovSim: an LLM Agent Harness with Bounded Context for Long-Horizon Computational Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35349v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent studies have applied large language model (LLM) agent systems to computational simulation workflows. Such workflows are long-horizon, so the information generated can exceed what an LLM can reason over at once, its context window. Context management is therefore essential, yet existing systems have either neglected it or treated it as a supporting mechanism rather than a subject of study. This paper presents MarkovSim, an LLM agent harness for long-horizon computational simulation, whose core is a context management scheme built into the workflow. The workflow record is written to a memory system with a predefined schema, and at workflow-defined boundaries, namely the state transitions of a finite-state machine a compact representation of the solution progress is constructed from it as the agent's context. translated_title: MarkovSim：一种具有有界上下文的LLM智能体框架，用于长时程计算仿真
translated_abstract: 近期研究已将大语言模型（LLM）智能体系统应用于计算仿真工作流。此类工作流具有长时程特性，因此产生的信息可能超出LLM单次可推理的范围，即其上下文窗口。因此，上下文管理至关重要，然而现有系统要么忽视了这一问题，要么仅将其视为辅助机制而非研究对象。本文提出了MarkovSim，一个面向长时程计算仿真的LLM智能体框架，其核心是内置于工作流中的上下文管理方案。工作流记录被写入一个具有预定义模式的记忆系统中，并在工作流定义的边界处（即有限状态机的状态转换时），从中构建解决方案进度的紧凑表示作为智能体的上下文。该方案在有限元分析上实例化，并在六个基准问题上进行评估，MarkovSim在18次运行中通过了16次，并正确……
tldr: MarkovSim是一种面向长时程计算仿真的LLM智能体框架，其核心创新在于将上下文管理内置于工作流中——通过预定义模式的记忆系统存储工作流记录，并在有限状态机状态转换的边界处构建紧凑的进度表示作为智能体上下文，在有限元分析的六个基准问题上18次运行通过了16次。
en_tdlr: MarkovSim is an LLM agent harness for long-horizon computational simulation whose core contribution is a workflow-embedded context management scheme that stores records in a memory system with a predefined schema and constructs compact progress representations at finite-state machine transitions as the agent's context, achieving 16 successful runs out of 18 on six finite element analysis benchmarks.
